speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma

The presence of a fixed, painless supraclavicular lymph node alongside significant weight loss and night sweats is highly suggestive of lymphoma. The abdominal pain may indicate gastrointestinal involvement or hepatosplenomegaly. While the labs and chest X-ray results are pending, the clinical picture strongly points toward a malignancy rather than a simple infection.
